title: The 3 Best Plugins for Claude Code
description: There are hundreds of plugins for Claude Code, but most aren't worth your time. These three are the ones I install on every fresh setup. The first is the official Anthropic pack, which is curated and maintained by the Anthropic team. The second is the GitHub plugin, which lets Claude handle your pull requests and reviews directly. And the third is a testing plugin that runs your tests, fixes failures, and reports back automatically. Each one installs in under a minute and they're all free.
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
transcript: Here are the three best Claude code plugins that you need to install today. Start with the official Anthropic pack. This one's built and maintained by the Anthropic team themselves. And it's basically a curated set of the most useful things you could plug into Claude. It covers everything from formatting to research to document workflows. Next up is the GitHub plugin. Once it's installed, Claude can handle your pull requests, your issues, and your code reviews all without you leaving the conversation. If you write any code, this one's a no-brainer. And the third is the testing plugin. Claude runs your tests for you, catches the failures, fixes them, and reports back. It's basically a junior engineer that doesn't sleep. All three install in under a minute, and they're free. Comment plugins and I'll send you the curated list with install commands.
